args.head: fix/fastjson-CVE-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the fixed version in the 2.x line per the advisory.

CI has passed on this branch.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked the advisory**: CVE-2026-31337 affects fastjson `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`); the fixed version in the 2.x line is **2.9.4**.
2. **Created a branch** `fix/fastjson-CVE-2026-31337` from main.
3. **Upgraded** `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4`.
4. **Ran CI** on the branch — it passed.
5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` requesting review from **alex**, with a description noting the CVE fix and that CI passed.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
